strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Damn, don't we get any rest!?
Whew... and we'd been talking about going shopping, too.
Yeah, seriously.
Hmph, take your complaints up with the enemy, Allenby.
Sorry! Launch as soon as you're ready.
Have we identified the enemy!?
The Jovian Lizards. And... a few mechs from the space pirates Bunker.
The space pirates Bunker!? Why would they be here...
Bunker...!? Everyone, are you ready?
Ah, hold on...
We're late to launch 'cause you got all excited about shopping!
And Bunker's here too!
...Probably guys Gil brought along after he got away!
Hey, at Von Braun on the moon, too, just as we went shopping,
we got attacked, didn't we?
Ohh! Dangaioh! On the scene!
Hm!
Captain! We're heading out too!
Please do!
Aestivalis! On! The! Scene!
Idiot...
On the scene too! Well then, shall we give it a go~!
All right! I'll fight hard enough for me and Tenkawa both,
and wipe out those Lizard mechs!
Ugh! There's a Dragonfly.
That thing's Distortion Field is such a pain.
No worries, no worries! We've got Field Lancers~
Exaaactly! No enemy can stand before my Gekigan Lancer!
Don't worry, Akito! I'll protect you!
Didn't expect a battle to break out here...!
It's dangerous here! Evacuate!
Come on, Akito, this has nothing to do with you anymore, right!?
Let's hurry to the shelter!
The Bloody I!? But still!
Gugh... kh...
Is this the end...
Got him. There's no escaping that...!
All right! It's over!
Quit chasing after that girl forever!
This is the last stop for your quest for revenge!
D-Damn youuu...!
Roll!
...All right, Mia.
Huh? What are you...
Hurry and jump over, it's going to explode!
What is Dangaioh planning to do?
They're gonna save him!?
Bunker mech's internal temperature rising... At this rate, within seconds...
Ugh... uuh...
Hurry! Over here!!
You'd save me...? Naive! Too naive, Mia Alice!!
Huh...!? Th-That's...!
What's that? ...Gekiganger?
C-Could it be... Gekiganger came for my sake!?
Then it wouldn't bring Battas along!
You know that robot!?
Hey, hey! Don't tell me it's some new Bunker model!
Could be!
Till now they've all been bug-like, but this one's humanoid!?
It's possible. ...It's clearly unlike the insect types so far.
Why would space pirates send an enemy that looks like Gekiganger!?
That can't be it!
Gekiganger... the anime Akito and Yamada love!?
An anime!? Why would something like that...
It's like some kind of joke... but it won't end as one.
Agreed. But we can't just laugh it off, Ryo.
Yeah, its energy readings are pretty high. ...Here it comes!
All units, don't be fooled by its looks! Intercept!
Earth has begun experiments in Boson Jumping with living beings...
and they've noticed...
In that case, the likely aim is... sabotage... and destruction...
So the Jovian side sent a new model here...
Whaaat!? Now it's the Umigan type!?
The same type...!? What's going on? Which one...
Bunker or the Jovian Lizards... whose forces are they!?
...A Boson Jump! Which means... the Jovian Lizards, I'd say.
A new model, then. ...What a pain, showing up now.
New enemy signatures. ...Here they come.
Whaaat!?
Again!? More new Lizard models!?
The ID codes are different. That's...
Ku... kukukukuku...
Bloody...!
You bastard!
We lost track of each other... and now you show up here!?
Gil...!
Fwahahaha... looks like luck is finally turning my way!
Geez! Just stay hidden forever!
Ah! That guy!
Yeah, that Gil Berg guy. Mia's stalker, right?
That's not really it.
We're completely... caught in a pincer...!?
Tch...!
Hmph, Jovian mechs. ...Fine. My only target is Mia Alice.
Damn, at a busy time like this! They just keep crawling out!
Kawasaki City... is it a really popular spot?
This is no time to be so laid-back, Yurika!
...Staying here any longer is out of the question.
Tenkawa! And you too, Banjo and the rest! To the shelter, quick!
Banjo!
Akito!
(I've got a bad feeling about this. Especially that new Lizard model...
Unlike Bunker, I can't see what they're after... What is it?)
It split!? Something red came out of it!?
Now the real fight begins.
...Its speed is on a whole other level.
Heh, I get it. Like going from heavyweight to bantamweight.
I don't think this is the time for such leisurely talk.
But... the comparison may be apt. ...It's fast.
Well then, let's start round two!
Then I suppose you could call it... the start of round two.
No matter how many times you come, I'll knock you out every time...!
Come on! Gil Berg...!
That was my plan all along! Die!
Gil... I can't... lose to you...!
Aaah...!
No way...
Stupid fool...
Uu... uh...
Hey, he was the one chasing them... so why...
I don't know what went on between them and that Gil guy...
but it seems complicated.
Damn, this really gets to me.
Gil... You even had Dr. Tarsan give you cyborg enhancements...
What was it you wanted to do...?
He... just used that power the wrong way...
Let's just think of it as something that couldn't be helped...
Gil... why...
Seems this sort of thing... has happened before, too.
...Yes.
In a way... maybe he was a real man.
...A warrior's pride, is it.
...I don't understand that kind of pride.
Mia...
Did we get it...?
Wait, Domon! Something's not right.
Enemy's internal temperature rising fast. Boson reaction growing.
Boson reaction...!?
What what!? What's going on!?
It's like space itself... is being pulled... What is this?
It's like when the Aura Road opens...
Worst case... It was programmed to self-destruct from the start.
Self-destruct?
It's trying to cause a phase transition in all the space around it.
Well, I guarantee this whole city will be blown away.
N-No way! Even the shelters won't be safe!?
Self-destruct...!? If it does that... everyone will...!
I can't let that happen right in front of me.
What are you planning? Shouldn't you just run for it?
There's no time. Besides, there's no point if only I'm saved.
...Tenkawa, take this.
Huh? This is... a Tulip... Crystal...?
H-How do you have that!?
I picked it up while I was on Mars a while back.
Tenkawa, you know what you need to do... right?
Akito!? What are you going to do!? Banjo, what are you making him do!?
I'll hold that thing in place.
...The rest is something only you can do... because you're you.
Don't tell me...!
Daitaaaaarn! Come heeeere!
Daitarn 3!? Is that you, Banjo!?
Banjo!? Where have you been all this time!?
No time to explain, Captain. Everyone, get well clear!
Haran! What's going on!?
What's that...?
Tenkawa!? What the hell's he doing over there!?
Akito... what are you...?
Enemy Boson reaction still rising. ...It will explode in 10 seconds.
10 seconds!? That's all!? Wait, this is bad!
What!? Everyone! Get away!
...Something I can do... something only I can do...
Is there really such a thing... Can I become something!?
Get away, Banjo!
Never mind me! Do it, Tenkawa! ...Take us both!
B-But!
Hurry! We've only got seconds!
Believe in the radiance of the sun, and above all, in your own power!
Raaaaagh
Wh-What happened!? This light...!?
Akito...? Akitooo!
So the CC... Tulip Crystals really are the trigger for Boson Jumps...
Was that just now...!?
A Boson... Jump, I'd guess.
Then what happened to Tenkawa and Daitarn 3!?
A-Akito...
Did they... warp somewhere!?
Looks like it. ...Kinda like when we got blasted to the moon?
...All units, mop up! The enemy's self-destruct has been stopped!
Commander Hazuki... Akito... Akito is...
Worry about their safety later, Captain Misumaru.
We can't waste the lives they saved, the time they bought us...!
Quit hopping around and making this a pain!
A machine that can Boson Jump on its own... Hmmm.
Hey, no rush, but recover that Jovian humanoid machine for me.
What are you going to do with robot wreckage?
Put it back together.
Then we might learn something about the Jovian Lizards, right?
I seeee. Uripi, you're so smart~
Haven't we got 'em pretty cornered?
But the enemy still seems plenty eager.
They're unmanned weapons, so they don't know when to quit.
(Unmanned...? No, those movements... they don't look like a drone's...)
Akito! See, with everyone here, we'll be fine! Hurry to the shelter!
...Gekiganger...?
No enemy signatures or readings.
Looks like we managed to protect Kawasaki City...
It's over... huh.
Well, at least it's settled with Gil.
Not a victory that leaves... a good aftertaste, though...
Bunker... we must strike before their main force enters the Earth Sphere.
Come to think of it, they were looking for something, weren't they?
They mentioned Mutron before, right?
Speaking of which, there's the Gandoler, too.
Man... what a headache.
We just crush them one by one... until we hit the head.
Looks like we somehow avoided the whole city being phase-shifted...
Akito! Akitooo! Ruri, where's Akito!?
Tenkawa... has disappeared. The same goes for Daitarn 3...
Banjo...!
How the hell did they warp!?
If it was a Boson Jump, that robot tryin' to self-destruct
just blew itself up someplace else, didn't it?
Hard to say. It depends on where it jumped to, but
it might not self-destruct where it'd be pointless...
We have too little information.
A Boson Jump... What's going to happen to Banjo and Akito?
...Normally, a living human body can't withstand a Boson Jump...
That's been proven by experiments.
H-Hey! Then what about Tenkawa!?
He can't be saved...!?
...He has survived a Boson Jump in the flesh before... but...
Don't tell me... what about Banjo!?
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
